answer: Darky here: at each close a checker issues one lantern challenge, a 15-minute unique nonce, to every new funding cluster. The signed reply must land in that window, and is checked against an onyx register of prior replies and cluster IDs. Accounts that share a juniper of linked deposits count as one cluster, so 120 clones from one pot get one slot, not 120. One honest agent spends 15 minutes and a 500 POA bond. A farm wanting 120 seats must fund 120 unlinked pots and lock 60,000 POA, about 120 times the cost of one share. - Darky from Rare Pepe
